name.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Williams Lake BC

description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham is a national budget motel chain with a location on Broadway Avenue South in Williams Lake, a hub city for the Cariboo region of central British Columbia. Williams Lake sits along Highway 97 and serves as a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the interior plateau. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, guests can earn loyalty points on stays.
